roundRobin.title: Automatic Distribution Settings

leastBusy.label: Least busy
leastBusy.desc: Every new conversation goes to the agent with the fewest currently open conversations.

roundRobin.label: Round robin
roundRobin.desc: Conversations are distributed in turn to available agents one by one, restarting from the first once it reaches the last.

roundRobin.mechanismHeading: How the full distribution mechanism works:
roundRobin.step1: 1. When a new conversation arrives, online agents whose status isn't "Busy" are identified.
roundRobin.step2: 2. Agents who've reached their maximum limit (if they have one set) are excluded.
roundRobin.step3: 3. Assignment follows the method selected above.
roundRobin.step4: 4. If all agents are at capacity, the conversation stays unassigned temporarily.
roundRobin.step5: 5. As soon as an agent becomes available (opens a chat or comes back online), waiting conversations are distributed to them automatically.
roundRobin.followupToggleLabel: Maximum wait time for a reply after follow-up
roundRobin.followupToggleSublabel: When a customer sends a new message in a "Follow-up" conversation, it stays with the same agent as usual. If enabled, and the agent doesn't reply within this time, the conversation moves to another online agent — or is unassigned if no one is online.
roundRobin.minutesHint: For example, 60 = one hour. This setting only affects follow-up conversations that were reopened, not regular open conversations.
